purpose: Each criterion of US-17505 driven through the app entry, bin/rcf.js, over the shared harness: a fixture project made by rcf init, seeded, frozen through rcf define freeze and read through rcf define readiness (text and --json), with the viewer's Readiness tab fetched from rcf audit view over loopback for the verdict and tree lines.
title: Readiness on a frozen tree with nothing pending: the freeze and readiness verbs through bin/rcf.js over a harness fixture project, and the Readiness tab served by the viewer for the same tree
